items.title: Solstice Stock Jumps After Calling Off a Major Acquisition
items.summary: Shares of  Solstice Advanced Materials  soared early Friday after the company called off a dramatic acquisition that would have turned the company into even more of an AI play.  In early July, Solstice announced a cash and stock deal to buy  Element Solutions  Element makes products used in semiconductor manufacturing.  Together, the companies would supply three legs of the AI value chain: The chips, the data centers, and the power that makes everything work.

items.title: Solstice Scraps Element Deal and Launches $500 Million Buyback
items.summary: Solstice will remain independent after abandoning its planned Element Solutions acquisition and authorizing a major share repurchase.

items.title: How Much Upside Can ETN Stock's Growth Deliver?
items.summary: Data center sales are not supposed to grow like this inside a century-old industrial. Yet Eaton's sales to the segment surged about 65% last quarter. The company is aggressively reframing its business as an unparalleled portfolio from grid to chip to capture this demand. This is not the slow-growth electrical supplier many investors still imagine.
